title: Pete Worden knows more about NASA UFO knowledge

tellings.quote: well what I've heard is that uh certain people uh like uh uh Pete Weren um >> know a lot more about NASA's knowledge about the UFO phenomenon

plain: A guest named Maaneli Derakhshani says he has heard that certain people, among them a man named Pete Worden, know a lot more than is public about what NASA, the US space agency, knows about UFOs. He passes this on as something others told him, without saying who, and if true it would mean the space agency holds UFO knowledge it has not shared.
